request.style: English, solemn female voice, solo, acoustic guitar, cello, soft percussion, minor key, slow tempo, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
An Egyptian father, an Israelite mother
The son of Shelomith, daughter of Dibri
From the tribe of Dan, he walked in the camp
A fight broke out, and the Name was blasphemed

[Pre-Chorus]
They brought him to Moses, held him in custody
Waiting for the will of the Lord to be known

[Chorus]
Take the blasphemer outside the camp
All who heard him lay hands on his head
The whole assembly is to stone him
As the LORD has commanded Moses

[Verse]
The Lord spoke down, saying to the leader
Anyone who curses God bears the sin
Whoever blasphemes the Name of the LORD
Must be put to death, foreigner or native

[Chorus]
Take the blasphemer outside the camp
All who heard him lay hands on his head
The whole assembly is to stone him
As the LORD has commanded Moses

[Outro]
So the Israelites did as the LORD commanded
They took him out, and they stoned him to death
